'''Tranquilizer pistols''' were [[Tranquilizer dart/Legends|dart]]-shooting projectile weapons. They were commonly used by [[Big game hunter/Legends|big-game hunters]] and [[veterinarian]]s to sedate animals that had become frightened or injured. The [[Neegad 7 Tranquilizer Pistol]] was a model of tranquilizer pistol used during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].
